BallestConsoleCommand.AtLeastOne: Choose at least one ghost. Use ballest.Swarm 0 to hide the swarm.
BallestConsoleCommand.CacheArgument: Only GhostSwarm accepts a cache argument: ballest.GhostSwarm n 1 (use cache, default) or n 0 (refresh).
BallestConsoleCommand.NumericArguments: Type help for commands. Ghost commands require numeric arguments; omit brackets when typing.
BallestConsoleCommand.PivotArguments: Use ballest.editor.pivot to report the current pivot, or add default, center, bottom, top, left, right, back or front.
BallestConsoleCommand.PrefabArguments: Use a prefab command followed by its name. Only saveprefab accepts confirm after an overwrite prompt.
BallestConsoleCommand.PrefabName: Use a prefab name of 1 to 64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, without brackets.
BallestConsoleCommand.PreviewArguments: In Ballest's console, preview commands take no arguments and use the current draft. Use Unreal's console for an explicit .balledit path.
BallestConsoleCommand.SwarmArguments: Type ballest.Swarm 0 or ballest.Swarm 1, without brackets.
BallestConsoleCommand.SwarmVisibility: Type ballest.Swarm 0 to hide the swarm or ballest.Swarm 1 to show it.
BallestConsoleCommand.UnknownCommand: Unknown command. Type help for the available commands.
BallestConsoleCommand.WholeNumber: Use a whole number without brackets, for example: ballest.GhostSwarm 100.

BallestConsoleCommandHelp.DeletePrefabDescription: Delete the named prefab JSON file from Saved/SaveGames/Prefabs. Placed copies in the level are unaffected.
BallestConsoleCommandHelp.GhostSwarmDescription: Play ghosts from leaderboard ranks 1 through n. Cache: 1 uses matching cached replays (default); 0 refreshes. Type numbers without brackets.
BallestConsoleCommandHelp.HelpDescription: List commands. Use Up/Down to browse; the focused command's description appears beside the entry. Ctrl+Up/Down recalls history. Help keeps the console open.
BallestConsoleCommandHelp.ListPrefabsDescription: List local prefab JSON files and their folder. Prefab commands require the level editor. The console stays open to read the result.
BallestConsoleCommandHelp.PivotDescription: Without an argument, report the current selection's pivot and position and keep the console open. Add a preset to change one ungrouped item's editor pivot without moving it. The change supports Undo/Redo.
BallestConsoleCommandHelp.PreviewDescription: Unreal Editor only, standalone play session: convert the current draft to a temporary .ballmap and play it. Uses the existing local preview validation bypass. ReturnToEditor restores the captured draft.
BallestConsoleCommandHelp.ReloadPreviewDescription: Unreal Editor only: play the last temporary preview .ballmap again in this standalone session.
BallestConsoleCommandHelp.ReturnToEditorDescription: Unreal Editor only: return from playback to the draft captured before preview, including its editor groups, pivots and camera.
BallestConsoleCommandHelp.SavePrefabDescription: Save 2 or more selected items as editable JSON in Saved/SaveGames/Prefabs. Ungrouped selections use their bounds center without changing the level's groups. MP_PlayerStart is forbidden. Existing names prompt for a second command with confirm. Names use letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
BallestConsoleCommandHelp.SpawnPrefabDescription: In the host or standalone level editor, spawn a saved prefab in front of the camera as a selected group. Undo removes the complete spawn. New items use Default pivots.
BallestConsoleCommandHelp.SwarmDescription: 0 hides the swarm or cancels loading. 1 shows the loaded swarm.
BallestConsoleCommandHelp.TagsDescription: 0 is automatic: hide other tags above 15 visible ghosts, but keep the current POV ghost's tag. 1 hides all tags, including POV. 2 has no tag count limit.
